# HITL Value Stream Profile (docx/pdf) — Locked Design Spec

**Status:** Approved by Tim King, August 9, 2026, first pass. This is the canonical spec for `hitl_valuestream_<slug>_final.docx`. Generated by the stream-parameter-driven script `gen_stream_profile.js`, invoked as:

```
node gen_stream_profile.js <path-to-domain-json> "<Stream Name>" <output-slug>
# e.g. node gen_stream_profile.js pcf7_full.json "Recruit-to-Hire" recruit_to_hire_pcf7
#      node gen_stream_profile.js pcf7_full.json "Enable & Govern" enable_and_govern_pcf7
```

The script takes the domain's extracted JSON (the same shape `gen_maturity.js`/`gen_domain_raci.js` consume — `valueStreams[]`, `groups[].l3[].l4[]`, `lenses.{descriptions,kpis,designNarrative,handoffPoints,governance,roles}`) plus a stream name, and produces `hitl_valuestream_<slug>_final.docx`. Content and section logic are copied 1:1 from the dashboard's own `renderDescriptionPanel()` function in `index.html` (`getStreamL3s`, `countPatternsForL3s`, `codeInStream`, `PATTERN_META`, `TIER_COLORS`) — not reconstructed from memory or an old doc. If the dashboard's render logic changes, re-derive this spec from the live function, not from this file's prose.

This doc type shares the locked visual language established by `hitl_maturity_<slug>_final.docx` / `hitl_raci_<slug>_final.docx` (see `HITL_Maturity_Docx_Spec.md`) — Segoe UI, navy banner, bordered stat cards, thinBorder(), caps+bottom-aligned header rows — adapted to a portrait, section-stacked layout rather than landscape/wide-hierarchy-grid.

---

## 1. Page setup

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Orientation | **Portrait** — per-entity doc types stay portrait (unlike the domain-wide landscape docs); this is prose/section-stacked, not a wide L1–L4 grid |
| Page size | 12240 × 15840 (DXA, US Letter) |
| Margins | top 1000, right 1100, bottom 1000, left 1100, header 708, footer 708 |
| Usable content width | 10040 DXA (= 12240 − 1100×2) — every table is percentage-based against this |
| Document default font | **Segoe UI** (`styles.default.document.run.font`) — same as every other locked doc type |

## 2. Repeating page header (word header, every page)

| Line | Text | Style |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | "The Human-AI Partnership Framework" | bold, color `1B4F8A`, size 13, spacing after 20 |
| 2 | "`{d.pcf}` — `{Stream Name}` — Value Stream Profile" | italic, color `888888`, size 13 — `d.pcf` already contains the "PCF" prefix (e.g. "PCF 7.2"), do not prepend it again |

## 3. Footer (every page)

Centered: `Page {CURRENT} of {TOTAL}` — color `888888`, size 13. Matches Maturity/RACI (not the older standalone-RACI doc's right-aligned footer).

## 4. Body-opening banner (one-time, in-body)

Identical to Maturity/RACI — reused verbatim, same function. Full-width single-cell table, no borders, navy `0D2D4F` fill, Georgia white title (28/bold) + light-blue italic tagline (16).

## 5. Title block

| Element | Style |
|---|---|
| `{Stream Name}` (e.g. "Recruit-to-Hire") | font Georgia, bold, color `0D2D4F`, size 30, spacing before 220 after 40 |
| "`{d.pcf}` — `{d.subtitle}` — Value Stream Profile" | italic, color `888888`, size 17, spacing after 200 |

## 6. Section order (ground truth: `renderDescriptionPanel()` in index.html)

1. Narrative paragraphs (`d.narrative[]`) — **no heading**, directly under the title block
2. Stats row (5 cards, one row — see §7)
3. **KPIs** (only if `lenses.kpis` has an entry for this stream)
4. **Design Narrative** (only if `lenses.designNarrative[stream]` is non-empty)
5. **AI Capability Map** (always — all 5 patterns shown, 0-count patterns get an explicit "no activities" note rather than being omitted)
6. **Process Accountability** (only if the stream has any L3s — always true in practice)
7. **Handoff Points** (only if `lenses.handoffPoints[stream]` has entries)
8. **Governed Decision Points** (always — renders either the table or the standard empty-state sentence, never omitted entirely)
9. Attribution line: "© Timothy P. King & Claude (Anthropic) 2026" — italic, `888888`, size 13

Section headings (except narrative-opening and stats): bold, color `0D2D4F`, size 19, spacing before 260 after 40. Optional caption line below (KPIs and AI Capability Map both get one from the dashboard's own `lens-note` text): color `888888`, size 14.

## 7. Stats row (5 cards, single row — not Maturity's 6-card 3×2 grid)

Column widths: 2008 DXA × 5 (≈100% split 5 ways). Same `statCell()` styling as Maturity: bordered (`thinBorder()`), fill `FAFBFD`, margins top 120/bottom 120/left 140/right 100. Label color `888888` size 12 (one point smaller than Maturity's 13, since 5 labels are tighter than 3); value bold `1B4F8A` size 22.

| Card | Label | Value |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | L3 PROCESSES | `d.l3Count` |
| 2 | L4 ACTIVITIES | `d.activityUnits` |
| 3 | M1 BASELINE H% | `d.m1`% |
| 4 | M3 DESIGN INTENT H% | `d.m3`% |
| 5 | Δ M1 → M3 | `d.delta`% |

## 8. KPIs table

Columns (DXA, sum 10040): Metric+Formula 7530 / Source 2510. Header row: navy fill, white bold caps, bottom-aligned (identical `headerCell()` helper to Maturity/RACI). Body rows alternate `FFFFFF`/`FAFBFD` stripe. Metric cell: bold name (gray, size 15) + formula as a second paragraph in the same cell (italic, `888888`, size 13) when a formula exists. Source cell: gray size 14, em dash when `source` is null.

## 9. Design Narrative

Single prose paragraph (no table), gray `444444` size 18 — the exact `lenses.designNarrative[stream]` string, unedited.

## 10. AI Capability Map — 5 cards, single row, flat colored boxes (new element, no Maturity/RACI precedent)

Column widths: 1928 DXA × 5 cards + 100 DXA × 4 spacers = 10040. Each card: **no border**, background fill = `PATTERN_META[pattern].fill` (pale tone), all text in `PATTERN_META[pattern].text` (dark tone) — same five-pattern palette as the badge fills used elsewhere, but as a full card background rather than a small badge. Margins top/bottom 140, left/right 120.

Card content, top to bottom: pattern name (bold, size 15) → tagline (italic, size 10, `PATTERN_META[pattern].tagline` verbatim) → count line (bold, size 15: "`{n}` L4 activities") → either the M1→M3 H% line (size 12: "M1 `{m1}`% → M3 `{m3}`%") when count > 0, or an italic "No activities of this pattern in this value stream" note (size 11) when count is 0. Counts and H% values come from `countPatternsForL3s(getStreamL3s(...))` and the fixed `PATTERN_META` table — never omit a 0-count pattern card.

## 11. Process Accountability table

Columns (DXA, sum 10040): Process Accountability (role name) 2900 / Tier 1600 (centered) / L3 Processes 3540 / L4 Activities 2000 (centered). Header row: navy/white/caps/bottom-aligned, same as KPIs. Data derived live from `l3.raci.A` per L3 in the stream (role → accumulated L3 code list + L4 activity count), not from any separate roles list. Tier cell: filled with `TIER_COLORS[tier].fill`, bold text `TIER_COLORS[tier].text`, centered, size 12 — tier resolved via `d.roles[]` lookup (stripping a trailing `*` for external participants), falling back to "External Participant". Body rows alternate `FFFFFF`/`FAFBFD` stripe (role, L3-code-list, and L4-count cells share the row stripe; tier cell keeps its own tier-color fill regardless of stripe).

## 12. Handoff Points

One prose paragraph per array entry in `lenses.handoffPoints[stream]` — gray `444444` size 18, no numbering/bullets (matches the dashboard's plain `<p>` rendering).

## 13. Governed Decision Points table

Columns (DXA, sum 10040): PCF 780 / Decision 1900 / Authority 1400 / Impact 1900 / Escalates To 1460 / Trigger 2600. Header caps navy/white/bottom-aligned. Data = `lenses.governance[]` filtered via `codeInStream(g.code, stream)` (matches on the stream's `l2codes` prefix or explicit `l3codes`). PCF code cell: black text, size 13 (matches the black-PCF-code convention from Maturity/RACI). All other cells gray, size 13, alternating stripe.

**Empty case (no Decision/Exception-pattern activity in the stream):** render the section heading only, followed by the fixed sentence — italic, `888888`, size 14 — "No Decision- or Exception-pattern activity in this value stream — every step here is Knowledge, Document, Transaction, or Mixed without an embedded Decision/Exception component." No table in this case. Confirmed working correctly for Reward-to-Retain (PCF 7.5), which has zero Decision-pattern activity.

## 14. Colors reused from the locked Maturity/RACI palette

NAVY `1B4F8A`, NAVY_D `0D2D4F`, GRAY `444444`. `PATTERN_TEXT` dark palette imported but currently unused directly in this doc type (AI Capability Map uses `PATTERN_META` fill/text pairs instead, which are numerically identical to `PATTERN_BADGE_FILL`/`PATTERN_TEXT` but sourced from the dashboard's own `PATTERN_META` constant for exactness). `TIER_COLORS` is new to this doc type — copied verbatim from `index.html`.

## Build/validation checklist for any new stream

1. Confirm the stream name exact-matches an entry in the domain JSON's `valueStreams[]` and `lenses.descriptions[]` — the script exits with an error naming the missing lookup if either is absent, rather than generating a partial doc.
2. Run `node gen_stream_profile.js <domain>.json "<Stream Name>" <slug>`.
3. Convert to PDF and rasterize every page — confirm: banner present, header line 2 doesn't double "PCF", 5-stat row bordered, KPI table only appears when the stream has KPI data, AI Capability Map always shows all 5 cards (including 0-count ones with the empty-note text, never a missing card), Process Accountability table role list matches the stream's real RACI-A holders, Governed Decision Points renders either the table or the fixed empty-state sentence (never blank).
4. Unzip and grep `word/document.xml` to confirm the Segoe UI docDefault font and `w:caps`/`w:vAlign` on header cells, same as the Maturity/RACI validation habit — never trust a LibreOffice render alone.

- `gen_stream_raci.js` (the per-stream RACI companion doc) still has NOT received this round of fixes — remains on the old pre-locked-spec styling, same as noted in `HITL_Maturity_Docx_Spec.md`.
